findings.claim: Qwen Code has a code mode (tools.codeModeOnly) in which ordinary and MCP tools run inside one `exec` JS tool through a nested scheduler. The docs cover only OpenCode codemode. Hook names, matchers (TECH-SPEC 3.8 rule 2) and the ADR-0008/0016 cap do not cover Qwen `exec`.
findings.evidence: qwen-code packages/cli/src/config/settingsSchema.ts:2937-2945 'Expose ordinary tools through the isolated exec JavaScript tool'; core/src/tools/tool-names.ts:21 EXEC: 'exec'; core/src/core/coreToolScheduler.ts:1922-1937 nested hookContextSink hands nested hook context to the parent call; coreToolScheduler.ts:289-290 GATE_EXEMPT_TOOLS has ToolNames.EXEC (Qwen's own size gate skips exec output). TECH-SPEC.md:386 names only OpenCode.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: v1 Qwen matcher 050c30aa 2026-04-25 'fix(adapters): correct PreToolUse matchers with verified tool names' and 2a9ae3a9 2026-04-27 (#359). ORIGINAL_INTENT: src/adapters/qwen-code/index.ts:70-72 comment 'Qwen Code passes native tool names in hook stdin (verified from packages/core/src/tools/tool-names.ts)'. The v1 list has no `exec`. REGRESSION_RISK: v2 copies the v1 name list and misses every call made in code mode. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: names from recorded payloads only (#1222).
findings.fix: Add Qwen code mode to TECH-SPEC 3.8 and the GP-LIVE list: record a code-mode session, check whether PreToolUse/PostToolUse fire per nested call and with which tool_name, and add `exec` to the Qwen row in adapters/table.ts. Mark [U] until recorded.

findings.evidence: qwen-code core/src/tools/tool-names.ts:20-50 has no READ_MANY_FILES entry; read_many_files only appears as internal @path expansion (core/src/core/turn-budget.ts:118, tools/readManyFiles.ts:47). v1 cm-main src/adapters/qwen-code/index.ts:75 lists "read_many_files".

findings.claim: Qwen has its own output gate: results over 25,000 chars are written to disk and cut before the model sees them, but read_file and exec are exempt. The ADR does not say how the v2 cap sits next to this gate. On Qwen a large read_file output gets neither Qwen's gate nor a v2 cap (ADR-0008 says Read > 50 KB is hint only), so it enters the main or subagent context in full, against ADR-0016 MUST.
findings.evidence: qwen-code core/src/config/config.ts:986 DEFAULT_TRUNCATE_TOOL_OUTPUT_THRESHOLD = 25_000; coreToolScheduler.ts:7658-7666 gate; coreToolScheduler.ts:289-295 GATE_EXEMPT_TOOLS = EXEC, READ_FILE, READ_MCP_RESOURCE, ...; PostToolUse runs before the gate (coreToolScheduler.ts:6470-6503 then 6505 maybePersistLargeToolResult). ADR-0008:14 'Read of a file > 50 KB | hint | hint'.
findings.archaeology: No v1 behaviour changed by this finding (Qwen-side gate is host code).
findings.fix: Add a Qwen row: v2 cap must handle read_file and exec (the gate-exempt tools); for other tools say whether v2 acts before Qwen's 25K gate (PostToolUse runs first). Add a GP test with a 300 KB read_file on Qwen.

findings.claim: 'Qwen: replace only as reason/error text' is right but incomplete: a Qwen PostToolUse block marks the call as error EXECUTION_DENIED. The model sees a failed tool, not a result, which may make it retry the same call.
findings.evidence: qwen-code core/src/core/toolHookTriggers.ts:326-333 shouldStop -> stopReason; coreToolScheduler.ts:6470-6490 createErrorResponse(..., ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_DENIED); setStatusInternal(callId,'error').
findings.fix: Note in the row that case C on Qwen shows as a denied tool; the reason text must start with a line telling the model the call ran and not to retry. Add a live check (no repeat call).

findings.claim: S-SKILLS is open [U] for Qwen and the cited path is the model tool, but Qwen source answers it: extension skills from <ext>/skills load as slash commands, and disable-model-invocation is honored for extension skills.
findings.evidence: qwen-code packages/cli/src/services/SkillCommandLoader.ts:62 'Loads user-level, project-level, and extension-level skills as slash commands', :87-93; core/src/extension/extensionManager.ts:1968-1969 loadSkillsFromDir(`${effectiveExtensionPath}/skills`); core/src/skills/skill-load.ts:172-186 parses disable-model-invocation for extension skills.
findings.fix: Mark Qwen [V] in 3.9 with these lines; keep a live probe for the exact command name (/ctx-stats vs namespaced).

findings.claim: Rollback exists only for git-checkout installs. For Qwen (host-managed) the ADR names no rollback step; `qwen extensions update` has no version pin.
findings.evidence: ADR-0010:42-47 rollback only under step 3 (git checkout). qwen-code packages/cli/src/commands/extensions/update.ts:144 'update [<name>] [--all]' (no --ref); install.ts:171-176 has --ref.
findings.fix: Add the Qwen/Gemini rollback: `qwen extensions uninstall context-mode` then `install <url> --ref <previous release commit or tag>`, and say which ref /release keeps.

findings.claim: Doctor has no check for Qwen safe mode. QWEN_CODE_SAFE_MODE turns off hooks, extensions, skills and MCP servers, so every Qwen check fails with no cause shown.
findings.evidence: qwen-code core/src/utils/safe-mode.ts:9 SAFE_MODE_ENV_VAR = 'QWEN_CODE_SAFE_MODE'; core/src/config/config.ts:3645-3647 'Safe mode active: hooks, extensions, skills, MCP servers, context files, rules disabled'.
findings.fix: Add a doctor row for Qwen: report safe/bare mode as the cause. Add the same field to the ADR-0014 debug report.
